"Then why don't we feel that same fear? We, too, are animals."

"Nah, only a funny smell during these times. Might be all the carcasses we're carrying down below, might be a werewolf. Can never be too sure."

"Indeed."

The watchman turned, entirely too late, and could only manage a strangled gasp as the ship's resident magician sank his bloody grin into the watchman.

The sanguine indulgence wouldn't be noticed. After all, there was only one full moon left before the ship docked. Any victims would be plenty inconspicuous in the cargo bay. But who next?
